reason: I'd download it the day I heard about it because it's free and I download everything, but I delete most apps within a week, and my class WhatsApp groups already ping me about everything. Unless it beats those groups, it'll be gone before the month is up.
objection: My WhatsApp groups already have the announcements, and people in them tell me what actually matters. One more app with more notifications just gets muted and then deleted.
would_change_my_mind: If it caught a deadline my WhatsApp groups missed, like a submission date a professor only posted on the portal. I did miss one last semester, so that would make me keep it.
